item.title: Kestra expands advanced planning under HNW estate lawyer
item.description: In a Q&A interview, Christine Brown explained her plans for the role leading a team of a half dozen specialists assisting Kestra financial advisors.

item.title: SEC moves to settle Commonwealth suit following $93M penalty reversal
item.description: The SEC's decision marks a startling reversal from the full-court press it had mounted against Commonwealth Financial Network in 2019 over alleged failures to disclose conflicts of interest in its brokers' mutual fund recommendations.

item.title: The first meeting with a client is critical. Here's how to get buy-in
item.description: The language that financial advisors use in their first interactions with prospective customers could make or break the relationship, according to an expert.

item.title: Why RIAs should steer clear of the private equity off-ramp
item.description: Internal succession planning is messier but aligns with a true fiduciary firm's core values, argues Neela Hummel of Abacus Wealth.

item.title: Raymond James launches dedicated ESOP advisory unit
item.description: Raymond James tapped industry veteran Mark Buchanan to lead a new ESOP advisory group focused on tax-advantaged succession strategies.

item.title: Senators grill UBS execs over Nazi-accounts investigation
item.description: At a hearing Tuesday, executives at the Swiss banking giant faced tough questions from both Republicans and Democrats. The lawmakers are unhappy with the bank's recent decision to withhold certain documents from a lawyer who's overseeing research regarding Nazi accounts.

item.title: How agentic AI is showing up in advisor workflows
item.description: As AI agents move from theory to reality, some advisors are implementing these tools into their technology stacks, but not without human oversight.

item.title: UBS continues to bleed assets as advisor departures slow
item.description: UBS Americas reported $14 billion in net new asset outflows in Q4, marking its worst period since the firm announced major compensation changes in November 2024.

item.title: Mutual funds are 25% unrealized capital gains, study suggests
item.description: None of the findings in a new working academic paper will likely surprise financial advisors. But they could provide some helpful data for conversations with investors.

item.title: Humility alone won't win next-gen clients. Here's what else will
item.description: A new McKinsey report on the future of wealth management identifies a disturbing trend: Younger investors are losing trust in advisors.
